view: Quiet ground-level excavation Qantir Nile Delta, shallow trench exposing fired-clay crucible fragments and vitrified furnace material, green fields and irrigation canal behind, no Tanis obelisks or standing Ramesses temples.

eras.title: A capital beneath the fields
eras.caption: At Qantir, remains beneath cultivated fields have helped locate Pi-Ramesses, the capital of Ramesses II. Excavations reveal royal buildings and specialised workshops rather than a complete city still standing above ground.
